# Pedagogical Research

> > An open-access academic journal publishing peer-reviewed research on teaching methodologies, educational innovation, and teacher professional development across science, mathematics, and interdisciplinary education.

Pedagogical Research is published by Modestum and features empirical studies, systematic reviews, and theoretical contributions exploring instructional design, context-based learning strategies like REACT, digital transformation in education, and teacher knowledge development. The journal emphasizes evidence-based pedagogical approaches across diverse educational contexts, with significant contributions from researchers in Turkey, Brazil, Ethiopia, and other international settings.

## Key Topics

- Science education
- Teacher education and professional development
- Mathematics education
- Instructional design
- Mixed methods research
- Systematic reviews
- Context-based learning and REACT strategy
- Conceptual understanding
- Distance learning and COVID-19 education
- Biology education
- Scientific reasoning
- Educational research methodology
- Digital transformation in schools
- Teacher knowledge for teaching
- Special needs education

## Science Education Research

- [Effect of context-based approach on students' scientific reasoning on heredity concepts](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/effect-of-context-based-approach-on-students-scientific-reasoning-on-heredity-concepts-13382): Context-based REACT strategy impact on 10th grade scientific reasoning skills
- [The Effect of Digital Storytelling Method in Science Education on Academic Achievement, Attitudes, and Motivations of Secondary School Students](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/the-effect-of-digital-storytelling-method-in-science-education-on-academic-achievement-attitudes-and-5835): Digital storytelling's impact on 6th grade science achievement & attitudes
- [Effect of 5E learning cycle assisted with concept maps on conceptual understanding](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/effect-of-5e-learning-cycle-assisted-with-concept-maps-on-conceptual-understanding-13167): 5E learning with concept maps improves 8th grade chemistry understanding
- [Investigation of the Pre-service Science Teachers' Perceptions of Protists](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/investigation-of-the-pre-service-science-teachers-perceptions-of-protists-9132): Drawing-writing technique reveals Turkish preservice teachers' protist understanding
- [Teaching Water Quality Analysis using a Constructed Wetlands Microcosm in a Non-Science Majors Environmental Science Laboratory](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/teaching-water-quality-analysis-using-a-constructed-wetlands-microcosm-in-a-non-science-majors-5945): Wetland filter demonstration for teaching water quality to non-majors

## Mathematics Education and Teacher Knowledge

- [Models of conceptualizing and measuring statistical knowledge for teaching: A critical review](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/models-of-conceptualizing-and-measuring-statistical-knowledge-for-teaching-a-critical-review-14031): Critical review of statistical knowledge for teaching models & measurement
- [Mathematics symbol instruction and senior secondary students' achievement in word problems: A quasi-experimental study](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/mathematics-symbol-instruction-and-senior-secondary-students-achievement-in-word-problems-a-12595): Symbol instruction strategy improves Nigerian students' word problem achievement
- [Construing Professional Knowledge of Secondary School Teachers of Mathematics: A Historical Perspective](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/construing-professional-knowledge-of-secondary-school-teachers-of-mathematics-a-historical-7898): Historical analysis of mathematics methodology at Coimbra Normal School 1912-1930
- [Roberto Mange: An Expert of Industrial Education](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/roberto-mange-an-expert-of-industrial-education-9357): Roberto Mange's innovations in Brazilian industrial mathematics education 1942-1968

## Research Methodology and Instructional Design

- [A Systematic Review of Research Questions in Mixed Methods Studies in Instructional Design](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/a-systematic-review-of-research-questions-in-mixed-methods-studies-in-instructional-design-11282): Systematic review of MMR question framing in instructional design research
- [A Systematic Review of Exploring the Potential of Teachable Agents in English Learning](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/a-systematic-review-of-exploring-the-potential-of-teachable-agents-in-english-learning-11553): Teachable agents' effectiveness in AI-assisted English language learning
- [A Method to Increase the Power of Monte Carlo Method: Increasing the Number of Iteration](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/a-method-to-increase-the-power-of-monte-carlo-method-increasing-the-number-of-iteration-6258): Monte Carlo iteration optimization for IRT test parameter estimation

## Digital Learning and Educational Technology

- [Promising Digital Schools: An Essential Need for an Educational Revolution](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/promising-digital-schools-an-essential-need-for-an-educational-revolution-11061): Framework for Lebanese schools' digital transformation using instructional design
- [Blended pedagogy for computer programming language](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/blended-pedagogy-for-computer-programming-language-14744): Hybrid C++ teaching with Bayesian analysis of self-efficacy & achievement
- [Students with Special Needs in Digital Classrooms during the COVID-19 Pandemic in Turkey](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/students-with-special-needs-in-digital-classrooms-during-the-covid-19-pandemic-in-turkey-9356): Turkish special needs students' challenges with COVID-19 distance learning
- [Beyond the Face-to-Face Learning: A Contextual Analysis](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/beyond-the-face-to-face-learning-a-contextual-analysis-8466): COVID-19's impact on transition from face-to-face to web-based learning

## Teacher Education and Professional Development

- [Participatory learning: Exploring place-based pedagogy for future teachers](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/participatory-learning-exploring-place-based-pedagogy-for-future-teachers-15155): Place-based knowledge integration in Nepal teacher education for sustainability
- [Developing professional identity: Narratives of preservice preschool teachers](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/developing-professional-identity-narratives-of-preservice-preschool-teachers-14048): Currere method reveals Turkish preservice preschool teachers' identity formation

## Optional

- [Knowledge to Teach and Knowledge for Teaching: New Theoretical-Methodological Contributions to the Research on Teaching and Mathematics Teacher Training](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/knowledge-to-teach-and-knowledge-for-teaching-new-theoretical-methodological-contributions-to-the-8318): Editorial on theoretical-methodological advances in mathematics teacher knowledge
- [The Contribution of the Literary Works of François Fénelon 'The Adventures of Telemachus, Son of Ulysses' and of Voltaire 'Candide', to the Cultivation of Humanitarian Awareness](https://www.pedagogicalresearch.com/article/the-contribution-of-the-literary-works-of-francois-fenelon-the-adventures-of-telemachus-son-of-5879): Fénelon & Voltaire's literary works foster humanitarian awareness & peace education
